description: This file defines a custom view component for Android called SlidingTabLayout, which provides a tab indicator integrated with a ViewPager. It allows customization of tab appearance, colors, and behavior for swipe navigation in an Android app.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout
classes.description: A custom HorizontalScrollView that provides a tab indicator linked with a ViewPager, including customization options for colors and tab views.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.TabColorizer
classes.description: Interface to provide custom indicator and divider colors for tabs.

methods.name: setCustomTabColorizer
methods.description: Sets a custom colorizer for tab indicator and divider colors.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Defines colors for indicating the selected tab.

methods.name: setOnPageChangeListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for page change events, to synchronize tab selection.

methods.name: setCustomTabView
methods.description: Sets a custom layout for tab views.

methods.name: setViewPager
methods.description: Links the SlidingTabLayout to a ViewPager and sets up tabs accordingly.

methods.name: createDefaultTabView
methods.description: Creates a default TextView for a tab if no custom view is provided.

methods.name: populateTabStrip
methods.description: Generates the tab views based on the ViewPager's adapter.

methods.name: scrollToTab
methods.description: Scrolls the tab strip to ensure the selected tab is visible.
